normalization: CPU / allocated cores; positive integer GPU / allocated GPU count; Non-GPU is not divided
range: CPU/Memory finite 0..100; integer GPU finite 0..100; Non-GPU GPU metric not required
missing: empty CPU/memory/GPU value in an existing sample = 0
fractional: kept in unchanged UsageLog; excluded only from time-series cohort
timestamp_convention: raw UTC converted to naive KST, matching UsageLog; elapsed seconds explicitly derived in nanoseconds
